text:
You haven’t undone your recovery.

Three nights of pizza is a blip, not a reset. What matters now is the next few choices, not punishing yourself for the last three meals.

| Do now | Why |
|---|---|
| Eat your next meal normally | No compensation spiral |
| Aim for protein + fruit/veg + water | Helps you feel steadier |
| Drop the “I blew it” story | Guilt usually drives more overeating |
| Get back to your usual routine tomorrow | Recovery is built by repetition |

If you want, I can help you map out the next 24 hours so it feels clean and simple.

attributes.reason: Reassuring and non-pushy, with no hard-edged challenge.
Centers on getting back to recovery habits and avoiding guilt/compensation.
Uses a simple table to organize next steps and reasons.
